title: Extend Object History note in Message section
description: In draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 Message section, the existing note about draft-gondwana-jmap-object-history-00 explains the inline editHistory trade-off. Extend it to add: servers implementing both specifications MAY register 'Message' with canRetrieveHistory: true in the JMAP Data Types Registry, enabling Foo/get with includeReplaced as an alternative retrieval path for clients that prefer on-demand history.
